name: workspace-walk
description: Read every active opted-in workspace with receipts
summary: At 6am, read new messages in every active eligible workspace and save counts and redacted findings.

kickoff.does: Reserve every eligible workspace with human activity in the last 24 hours.

browse.does: Read every reserved page and record a receipt for every workspace.

done.does: The workspace walk has complete receipts.

failed.does: The workspace walk is incomplete and cannot be used as a completed walk.
